title: SG-5.1 Layer order, render context, SceneObject and buildScene
summary: Scenes are built purely from content definitions into the six ordered layers
description: Context: game/src has the layer enum (content/schema.ts), the object schema and getSceneView, but no layer ordering, render context, scene object entity or scene-building step. Desired behavior: add these as one sequenced change with no concurrent writers, so a scene is built only from content definitions into background, furniture, objects, characters, effects and ui layers. Expected result: buildScene(ctx, scene) creates one entity per content object at the depth of its layer. Why: lets future content changes add objects without touching the engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given the six layers, when LAYER_ORDER is read, then it equals background, furniture, objects, characters, effects, ui in that order
Given a SceneSpec with objects on several layers, when buildScene runs, then one entity per object is created with depth ordered by layer
Given no hardcoded object ids in engine code, when a new object is added to scene content, then buildScene creates it without code changes

in_scope: game/src/engine layer order, render context and buildScene

technical_constraints: Modules must not import phaser; the render context is an injected interface
Reuse layerSchema, ObjectSpec and SceneSpec from game/src/content/schema.ts
definition_of_done: All three requirements have Act and Verify units passing
